title: Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program Status Limits: Past-Due Holds, Inpatient Holds and Program Time Limits
content:
Five tier figures govern when an Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program stops shipping or reaches the end of a waiting period.

**Past-due age.** The age, in calendar days after its posting date, at which an unpaid patient-balance posting becomes past due for the shipment hold test. A figure of 0 means shipments are never held for a past-due balance on the tier.

**Past-due hold amount.** The past-due amount, in USD, at or above which further shipments are held under the past-due rule.

**Inpatient hold.** Whether shipments must be held while the customer is an inpatient in a hospital or skilled nursing facility, because the payer does not pay home supplies during a covered stay.

**Hold limit.** The longest time a program may remain on hold, in calendar days counted from the hold start date, before it is closed administratively.

**Referral documentation window.** The time allowed to complete the referral documentation (written order on file and, where required, the prior authorization decided), in calendar days counted from the program's enrolled date.

| Tier | Past-due age (days) | Past-due hold amount (USD) | Inpatient hold | Hold limit (days) | Referral documentation window (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program | 15 | 50.00 | Not required | 180 | 30 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Commercial HMO Program | 90 | 75.00 | Required | 60 | 30 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Commercial PPO Program | 90 | 75.00 | Required | 90 | 30 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Program | 120 | 75.00 | Required | 90 | 30 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part D Program | 120 | 75.00 | Required | 90 | 30 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program | 120 | 75.00 | Required | 90 | 30 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicaid Program | 0 | 75.00 | Required | 60 | 30 |

## Remarks

- The Insulin Pharmacy Medicaid Program shows a past-due age of 0: shipments on that tier are never held for a past-due balance, whatever the amount; its 75.00 figure therefore has no hold to trigger.
- The Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program is the only tier on which an inpatient stay does not require a hold, and it has the shortest past-due age (15 days) and the longest hold limit (180 days).
- The referral documentation window is 30 calendar days on every tier.
